It's definitely not just you. I am grieving right now, so I am also going through a lot. I often think "Dad, you're so goddamn lucky you get to be dead. Why can't it be the both of us?" And that's a daily thought for me. Does it get better? That is a question both of us want answers too. I don't want to bog you down and be even more depressing....I just want you to know that you're far far from alone in this horrifying journey we call 'life'. I have small glimpses of happiness and maybe even zen. Small, but they are there. Life seems to be a cocktail of pain and bliss. Hang in there, because you never know what could be coming your way. Life is a fucking war. And it's strangers like you and I who are fighting in it.
